answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The lantern is the quoted measurement, the opal the group it forms, and the pearl the voice that group is worth; the lantern and the opal collapse a farm, while only a fresh pearl of hardware escapes the grouping.
